content: Wondering whether you're having a boy or girl? Our Chinese gender predictor, also known as the Chinese gender chart or Chinese gender calendar, forecasts your baby's sex based on an ancient Chinese gender chart and the Chinese lunar calendar. There's no scientific evidence that the Chinese gender predictor works. But since there are only two choices – boy or girl – it has at least a 50-50 chance of making an accurate prediction, a blood test that can detect Down syndrome and a few other chromosomal conditions.
